```plato

//==
// # Query results

// The result of sweeping a shape through the plane. Hit says whether anything
// was struck; Fraction is the normalized sweep parameter in [0, 1] at first
// contact; Position and Normal describe the world hit point in meters and the
// surface normal there; BodyIndex is the struck body (-1 = none).
type ShapeCastResult2D
    implements IValue
{
    Hit: Boolean;
    Fraction: Proportion;
    Position: Point2D;
    Normal: Direction2D;
    Body: BodyIndex;
}

// The result of sweeping a shape through space. Hit says whether anything was
// struck; Fraction is the normalized sweep parameter in [0, 1] at first
// contact; Position and Normal describe the world hit point in meters and the
// surface normal there; BodyIndex is the struck body (-1 = none).
type ShapeCastResult3D
    implements IValue
{
    Hit: Boolean;
    Fraction: Proportion;
    Position: Point3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    Body: BodyIndex;
}

// The result of an overlap query: the zero-based indices of every body whose
// colliders intersect the query shape.
type OverlapResult
    implements IValue
{
    BodyIndices: Array<BodyIndex>;
}
```
